structure.unit: Juvenile and Domestic Relations District Courts

law.catch_line: Litigating certain issues when the juvenile is incompetent
law.text: A finding of incompetency does not preclude the adjudication, at any time before trial, of a motion objecting to the sufficiency of the petition, nor does it preclude the adjudication of similar legal objections which, in the court's opinion, may be undertaken without the personal participation of the juvenile.
